construct.allocation: tight -> 0%% equity, else 100%% equity (no partial sizing)
construct.execution: decided on the close of bar t, held from bar t+1
construct.state: pct_rank(close_t within trailing 252 bars) >= 0.90 for 2 consecutive bars -> tight

honest: probe only: one construct, one frozen parameter set, no grid -- a positive here buys a frozen prereg and a proper judge, not a claim that the gate makes money
GC001's close is quoted annualised and is not the rate any particular position pays; a funding-stress level is a proxy for the price of leverage, not the price of our position
the rate panel starts 2011 but the equity leg starts 2020, so the probe only ever sees the recent shape of the funding cycle
the cash leg is an investable treasury ETF with its own positive return, so part of any excess is bond carry rather than timing
the circular null conserves the equity share, so a rule that is simply out of the market most of the time cannot win on share alone
the rate series is reindexed onto the equity calendar with a forward fill: a holiday carries the previous level, never a fabricated new one

null.method: circular phase rotation of the equity-weight series (conserves equity share and persistence)

verdict_block.note: supply verdict only: it decides whether this family earns a frozen prereg + judge, never what the judge will find
